material_findings: The runner invokes full independent result validation only with --allow-missing-validator-receipt. After creating validator-receipt.json, it calls only validate_validator_receipt against the earlier returned object and then publishes; it never performs the required final validate_result pass with the receipt required. Result bytes can therefore change after independent validation and before publication without full revalidation.
disposition: V18 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. A fresh V19 identity is required for correction.
